comments.author: Ming Mei
comments.body: Plague mostly happens because: Dirty deck never got cleaned. Turned into rat infestation. Rats never got killed. Turned into Plague. Clean your deck and kill rats, avoid 90% of all plague outbreaks. Scurvy doesn't happen often enough, either. Set aide to surgeon to avoid most if not all crew loss. Don't even need items 1/2 the time. Skill doesn't rank up, either. I agree, waste of a slot.

comments.author: George
comments.body:
and ofcourse 2 dumb traders and or adventurer's come in with a stupid opinion.

Its a must have skill if you are a maritimer, You run out of food in 8 days 10 tops with frugality, so unless you live in the greenzone, youll be getting scurvy and plaque alot when those run out, and sailing without food and water is how you rank survival.

Dont be narrowminded.

comments.author: Visitor
comments.body: As an alternative, there is the Asclepius' Medicated Bath item which can cure all crew-related status ailments, including scurvy, plague, malnutrition, and even sirens. It's a fairly common drop from the Endless Dungeons of the Labyrinth and, at times when Atlantis is present on the server, the Temple of Poseidon.
